name: stats
description: A grid of headline statistics. Each stat has a gradient-filled value, a label, and optional supporting copy. Ported from the live homepage stats band (#ap-stats-v3); used on the homepage between the hero and the comparison table.

eyebrow.description: Optional centred label above the stats (Ursa AI frame 7262:114721).

items.description: The stats. Each entry is an object with `value` (required), `label` (required) and optional `description`. Entries missing value or label are skipped.

columns.description: Columns above 991px. Always two columns at 991px and below, as on live.

theme.description: Background/foreground colour scheme. The live homepage band is `alt` (slate-50).

reveal.description: Stagger each stat in on scroll. The live homepage band has no entrance animation (false).
